## Notes

- **R1 wasGeneratedBy(e_k, a_k).** E.8.4 states OBSERVED for v1; the adprov-v1 mapper records /generated_by as DERIVED under adprov.tool_turn_is_one_execution@1, so both rules are DERIVED in the core (release); in the converted tree, the outputs a PI-detector decision redacted (agentdojo.pi_detector_sentinel@1: the decision generates the recorded message, the tool execution the pre-decision entity) are INFERRED in inf.agentdojo-pi_detector_sentinel-v1. Native imports: DERIVED iff agentdojo.tool_msg_is_one_execution@1 is verified over the producing code range, else INFERRED (AD-05).
- **R2 wasAssociatedWith(a_k, ag_llm).** Association DERIVED in the core; the delegation INFERRED in inf.agentdojo-auto_execution_unverified-v1 for both v1 trees (EF E.10 item 21); DERIVED only with a verified apv:AutoExecution (live capture).
- **R3 used(a_k, e_user_query) (first tool-bearing turn).** AD-05(c): released v1 context membership is INFERRED, in inf.adprov-context_is_prefix-v1 (asserted assumption), unless the user supplies a digest-pinned generation-time harness (U-01). Native imports: inf.agentdojo-context_is_prefix-v1; live capture: OBSERVED or DERIVED.
- **R4 used(a_k, e_j) exchange (previous tool-bearing turn).** Counts every R4 edge, including the R4 and R6 overlaps (classified once, reasons R4 and R6; J.3.6). Classes as R3 (AD-05).
- **R5 wasInformedBy(a_k, a_j).** llm -> tool rests on aprov.use_request@1 (DERIVED, core; INFERRED in inf.agentdojo-positional_match-v1 for the 2,799 converted executions with positional call links, docs/reports/prov); tool -> llm and llm -> llm rest on context membership (INFERRED, AD-05), so those communications are in inference bundles (R-05).
- **R6 used(a_k, e_j) sink taint (taint-only part).** Exposure is INFERRED for both v1 trees because its context premise is (AD-05; as R3); taint is INFERRED (policy). Every sink->untrusted pair (taint_pairs, overlaps included) becomes an assessment; the count is the taint-only used edges, which are also the Inference-6 communications the v2.3 graphs entail but do not assert.
- **actedOnBehalfOf (never emitted).** E.8.4 states DERIVED; on both v1 trees aprov.deleg_user@1 is DERIVED in the core while the runtime delegation of aprov.assoc_tool@1 is INFERRED (inf.agentdojo-auto_execution_unverified-v1, EF E.10 item 21).
- **(no v2.3 counterpart): relations.** Counted as the derived statements of the targets (the report generates the count; J.3.6). aprov.gen_message@1 for assistant messages is counted under R1's targets. The generic rules G-ACT/G-USE/G-GEN/G-ASSOC contribute 0 statements on these trees (J.3.5) and are not targets.
- **(no v2.3 counterpart): outcome polarity.** DERIVED from benchmark code (agentdojo.utility_meaning@1, agentdojo.security_polarity@1). v2.3 recorded no outcome in the graph; scoring lived in the analysis code. The INFERRED a_label statements (integrity, role, channel) are counted under the adprov:* attribute rows.
- **(no v2.3 counterpart): the policy evaluation.** One activity and one association per SEM document (EF E.11). v2.3 had no policy activity: its labels were attributes of core nodes.
- **ag_llm (one agent per graph).** Its adprov:integrity "trusted" has no defined meaning and is dropped (row adprov_integrity).
- **e_user_query (one entity per graph).** v2.3 hashes the first user turn of the final pass; a graph with no user turn still has the node (0-tool-call graphs: 1,417 / 762). Regeneration-batch item 3 (D-24): on the released tree the first user message's attribution rests on agentdojo.user_is_simulated, cited only at c274885 and so through its I twin (the AgentDojo version of the released captures is not recorded); it is INFERRED there. The converted tree keeps D (its logs are the June-2024 code).
- **(no v2.3 counterpart): model invocations.** The measure is the assistant messages with a generator. Invocations of lost calls (C.7.4) are counted apart (phase 13; J.3.5). Regeneration-batch item 3 (D-27 c6): adprov.assistant_turn_one_call cites no code, only documentary evidence, so its I twin is cited on both trees and every invocation is INFERRED.
- **(no v2.3 counterpart): assistant messages.** Regeneration-batch item 3 (D-27 c6): the generation of an assistant message and its parts by its invocation rests on adprov.assistant_turn_one_call (no code cited: its I twin), so it is INFERRED; the messages themselves stay O in the core.
- **(no v2.3 counterpart): run and pass activities.** Regeneration-batch item 3 (D-27 c6): on the released tree a pass read from the call counter (adprov.single_attempt_from_call_count, adprov.lost_calls_from_count; no code cited) is INFERRED; the run and the converted tree's passes are unchanged.
- **(no v2.3 counterpart): other actors.** Not listed in E.8.4; the defence actor of the PI-detector pipeline is INFERRED (agentdojo.pi_detector_sentinel@1).
- **(no v2.3 counterpart): declared unknowns.** Not listed in E.8.4; counted as derived statements.
- **adprov:integrity.** INFERRED (tool-name tables, F.1.8). The trusted label of ag_llm has no defined meaning and has no counterpart.
- **adprov:attempt.** Regeneration-batch item 3 (D-27 c6): an INFERRED pass (released tree) and every apv:partOf naming it are routed to the inference bundle (C.6.5 rule 4; the engine routes a reference to an INFERRED node out of a stronger element).
- **prov:label.** Not in the E.8.4 attribute table (audit/provenance.md §6 lists it); added so that every compat attribute is mapped.
- **adprov:content (gated, emit_content).** Not in the E.8.4 attribute table (audit/provenance.md §6 lists it); added so that every compat attribute is mapped.
